Configure line:
--disable-everything --disable-autodetect --disable-network --disable-doc --disable-debug --extra-ldflags=-static --enable-ffmpeg --enable-protocol=file --enable-demuxer=mov --enable-demuxer=matroska --enable-muxer=image2 --enable-decoder=h264 --enable-decoder=hevc --enable-decoder=mpeg4 --enable-decoder=vp8 --enable-decoder=vp9 --enable-decoder=av1 --enable-decoder=mjpeg --enable-parser=h264 --enable-parser=hevc --enable-parser=mpeg4video --enable-parser=vp8 --enable-parser=vp9 --enable-parser=av1 --enable-parser=mjpeg --enable-filter=select --enable-filter=reverse --enable-filter=scale --enable-encoder=mjpeg

Rook uses this payload only as an ffmpeg.exe subprocess for generated-video
poster, start_frame, and end_frame sidecar extraction.

The release source bundle is generated during release prep by
scripts\ffmpeg\build-rook-ffmpeg.ps1 and must be published beside the Rook
installer. Release validation requires the generated
rook-ffmpeg-source-bundle-manifest.json and verifies the source archive,
signature metadata, configure allowlist, bundle SHA-256, required bundle
contents, and extraction smoke fixtures.
